name: SteamSwap
fix_description: In sell, lpAmount is calculated using inner_pair.getReserves() which can be manipulated via flash loan. Additionally removeLiquidity uses 0,0 as min amounts (no slippage protection). Fix: use TWAP or internal accounting for reserve values, and set reasonable minimum output amounts.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, linear attack: flash loan BUSD, swap to STM, call updateAllowance, then repeatedly call sell and repay the loan. It appears to hinge on an obvious protocol-specific allowance/accounting flaw with minimal setup, few external interactions, and no complex cross-protocol reasoning beyond a basic flash-loan-funded token swap.
